messages:
Emma Chen: PRD intake — Dedicated autoscaling API
Emma Chen: Problem stmt: Customers on Dedicated need predictable scale + fast failover when models spike; currently manual pool resizing leads to outages and high latency during promos.
Emma Chen: Goal: expose an API and config that lets infra autoscale GPU pools by policy (target p95 latency, max cost delta), support per-customer policy, and allow safe canary rollouts.
Emma Chen: Non-goals: dashboards/UI (will come after API), model-level weight transfers, cross-region replication in v1.
Emma Chen: Success metrics: 99.9% traffic served within p95 SLO for 90% of customers, reduce manual scale ops by 80%, cost delta < +15% on average.
product-bot: Created ticket #PRD-423 in product-tracker
Ravi Patel: Q: Do we have a quant for "spike"? e.g., 2x baseline qps for 10m?
Emma Chen: thinking 2.5x sustained for 5m or 5x for 30s triggers — open to feedback
Sofia Martinez: Acceptance criteria (proposed):
- API: create/update/delete policy per-customer
- Simulator: can run workload replay and show scale decisions
- Integration test: under synthetic spike, latency stays under target with autoscale enabled
- Safety: fallback to reserved capacity if scale fails
Zach Turner: Edge cases:
- rapid oscillation / flapping between scale up/down
- multi-tenant GPUs where collocated jobs cause noisy neighbor
- warmup time for models with long init
Sofia Martinez: Implementation notes:
```
policy {
  target_latency_p95_ms: 120
  max_nodes: 16
  scale_step: 2
  cool_down_sec: 120
}
```
Ravi Patel: For canary, propose 10% traffic for 30m then 50% for 15m; rollback on 3 consecutive error-rate spikes > 3x baseline
Emma Chen: Launch criteria:
- API + CLI + tests merged
- 2 customers on dedicated pilot for at least 14 days
- Latency SLO met in pilot and integration tests
- Runbook and rollback tested
Zach Turner: Prioritization ask: tie to enterprise deals — several renewals asking for autoscale. If sales can get 2 pilot customers, move to P1.
Emma Chen: Next steps: assign owners for API spec (Ravi), simulator (Sofia), rollout plan (Zach). I'll draft PRD doc and ping for review by EOD Friday. :+1:
Ravi Patel: ack
Sofia Martinez: ack :eyes:
Zach Turner: ack
Emma Chen: tagging @eng-oncall for any infra constraints
eng-oncall: FYI: GPU pool autoscale will require scheduler changes; estimate 3 wks of infra work if no major surprises
Emma Chen: noted, will update timeline
